_note: STRAW MAN, narrow by design. Ground truth labels are authored against THIS file, so it is versioned and hashed before labeling starts (see 'provenance'). In the repo it lands at the root as bidder-profile.json and is loaded by the `decide` node.
name: EAP Software Solutions — narrow straw man
summary: A small independent cloud, AI-platform and data engineering practice. Bids on scoped advisory and implementation projects it can staff itself and deliver remotely. Does not supply software products, does not run operations, does not staff sites.

experience.comparable_engagements: 3–5 multi-month engagements in cloud, data and AI platform engineering; no prior K-12 implementations and no public-sector ERP or student-systems implementations
experience.contract_vehicles: none — no cooperative contract, state contract vehicle or framework agreement

capabilities.detail: assessment, migration strategy, landing zones, cut-over planning on AWS and Azure
capabilities.evidence: portfolio: full-stack-serving (container → Kubernetes → observability, measured and gated)

capabilities.detail: inference serving, model evaluation harnesses, RAG and agent pipelines, LLM application engineering
pipelines, warehouse modelling, API and system integration
IAM and zero-trust *strategy* — design and advice, not 24×7 security operations

accepted_delivery_models: discovery and strategy engagement producing a plan
ongoing advisory retainer at fractional commitment (≤ 2 days/week)
excluded_delivery_models: supplying a hosted product, platform or software licences (the firm ships services, not SKUs)
24×7 monitoring, service desk or managed-IT operations
regular on-site staffing, or an emergency on-site response commitment, outside DFW
hardware, cabling, physical security or network operations
excluded_capability_areas: ERP and student information system functional implementation
clinical, financial-services or public-sector work requiring a licence the firm does not hold
any engagement requiring a security clearance or US-federal clearance sponsorship
decision_rules_of_thumb: If the issuer is buying a product and the services are incidental, no-bid: the firm cannot supply the product.
If the winner must monitor, page or staff something continuously, no-bid: that is an operations business.
If winning requires a recurring on-site presence the firm cannot make, no-bid: geography is a hard constraint, not a scoring penalty.

If the requirement names a vendor-specific functional stack the firm does not hold (SAP, Workday, student systems, D365 functional configuration), no-bid unless the work is platform engineering underneath it.
Advisory, discovery and strategy engagements in cloud, IAM, data or AI are the core of the practice and are the default bid.

If a minimum track record, a contract vehicle or a credential makes the firm ineligible before capability is even assessed, no-bid: the work is unreachable rather than merely unwinnable, and no amount of proposal quality changes it.

provenance.derived_from: Capability statements that exist independently of the fixture set (portfolio repos, prior professional work). The fixtures were then inspected for DISCRIMINATION ONLY — to confirm the profile yields a spread rather than a uniform answer — and were not used to add or remove capabilities.
provenance.circularity_risk: Designing a profile while looking at the documents it will be judged on makes the labels partly self-fulfilling. Mitigation: this file is frozen and hashed before any label is authored, and the operating point is pre-registered (same pattern as the full-stack-serving ADR 0009 pre-registration).
provenance.authorship: drafted by personal-agent; to be adopted by Steven as the label-authoring baseline

revision.why: Sourcing round 3 surfaced two documents that turn on eligibility rather than capability — one requiring 'at least five (5) successful Texas K-12 implementations', another open only to holders of a pre-awarded statewide contract. No existing exclusion class could express 'we cannot bid on this even if we wanted to', which is a verdict a bid-triage tool has to be able to produce.
revision.effect_on_existing_labels: None. All eleven fixtures were re-checked for eligibility and minimum-experience gates by pattern search and none triggers the new class, so the previously authored labels and the pre-registered operating point survive this revision. That check is a pattern search, not an exhaustive reading, and is recorded as such.

excluded_eligibility_gates: a minimum number of prior comparable implementations the firm does not have, stated as a qualification rather than scored
holding a pre-awarded contract vehicle, cooperative contract or vendor partnership tier the firm lacks
a certification, licence, reseller authorisation or tier status the firm does not hold
a security clearance or federal clearance sponsorship
